_: Logistic regression over hashed word uni/bigrams (FNV-1a, 32768 buckets). Trained by tools/train_classifier.py on the TRAIN splits of deepset/prompt-injections (oversampled 6x) and xTRam1/safe-guard-prompt-injection. Threshold is the highest score reached by any of 209 ordinary business messages plus a 0.05 buffer -- never derived from a test split.
